title: Agospap
description: agospap.com zoominfo.com/c/agospap/357851962 AGOSPAP (founded 2 November 1981, Paris) is a non-profit association (loi 1901) that manages social, cultural and leisure benefits for ~150,000 staff of the AP-HP hospital system and the City of Paris plus ~20 affiliated public bodies — effectively a cross-institutional works-council fund. With 45 employees and income tied to 0.5% of the two founders' payroll (≈€28M/year in subsidies; €49M total budget), it provides income-scaled holiday stays, children's camps (4–17), a cultural ticketing platform, Christmas gifts, social grants (birth/marriage/service medals) and the new Pass'Sport sports voucher. Led by president Jean-Paul Brandela (since Oct 2023) and director-general Anne Schaetzel (since 2013), it is ISO 9001-certified and holds an Atout France travel-operator license with UNAT financial guarantees. Funding remains politically sensitive: a €2M cut by the City in 2023 briefly suspended camp registrations
